posts.subject: Serg's Mod/Admin application
posts.bodyHtml:
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is "Serg", and in-game, I go by "Serg" as well, but you might see me from time to time be called "Serg37TDS"
2) How old are you?
I am 14, and I am mature enough, in my view.
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
Because I have really taken a interest into your server lately (Knife Server). I really enjoy playing on it, and I play on it for like 1-2 hours a day, and during some of those times, no one is playing on it. And since the summer holidays have started, I can really start playing on your server for long periods of time.
4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have been playing on it for about 2 weeks now
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
I usually enjoy riding my bike, or drawing when im not busy. I really enjoy art and I have grown a interest into it. I drew a Glock Water Elemental, that can be found on my steam profile, if you want to see it.
6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
Yes, for my age I am mature. You'll never see me whine about and cry like those 9 year olds do.
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
Yes, I have been admin on 4 different servers.
[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
I play every day, during the weekends (Saturday and Sunday)I may play 2-3 hours, and during school days (Monday-Friday)I may play 1-2 hours.
9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
First, I would warn user 1 that disrespect towards other players is not aloud. I would tell him that this is his first warning and not to continue.
If he says it again, I will warn him again, and mute him for 15 minutes. If I unmute him and he continues to be disrespectful, I will place a 3-7 day ban for disrespect, depending on how serious it is (Racism, Rudeness, Mocking)
10) Strengths
Enjoy playing games, Able to solve problematic situations, Do not get angry quickly, I am able to keep calm in many situations, I enjoy listening to both sides of a story before making a decision on the punishments given out.
11) Weaknesses
I cannot play after 7PM (GMT +1), I really hate trolls, Don't like to play for more then 2 hours straight; so I take breaks here and then.
12) Conclusion / Closing remark
I hope you consider me as a good candidate for admin, I will not disappoint or abuse in any way, and I am sure that I would be a really good help to your staff team, seeing as how ShroudX got banned recently for scamming people.


Thanks for reading
-Serg
